description: This file defines a Path helper class that provides static methods for handling and manipulating file system and URL paths, including normalization, conversion between relative and absolute paths, and URL encoding/decoding within the KCFinder project.

classes.name: path
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for path manipulation and URL handling.

methods.name: rel2abs_url
methods.description: Returns an absolute URL path based on a relative path, incorporating the site's base URL from configuration.

methods.name: url2fullPath
methods.description: Resolves a relative URL to a full filesystem path by normalizing and combining it with server environment variables.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes a filesystem path, handling Windows backslashes, removing duplicate slashes, and resolving dot segments.

methods.name: urlPathEncode
methods.description: Encodes a URL path by normalizing and applying raw URL encoding to each segment.

methods.name: urlPathDecode
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded path back to its original form.
